title: Hours After the Plane Left

mood.label: Losing ground
mood.summary: A three-day pause over Kyiv ended the moment the envoys left; Yemen escalated, crude held near a three-month high, and fires and floods pushed people out. Small counterweights: a coal plant turning solar, AI steering fusion plasma.

lines: Three quiet days, then the sky came back —
hours after the plane lifted off Kyiv.
Sanaa gets promised to somebody again,
and crude sits at ninety-two like it's owed.
a Moroccan street turns into a river,
a border tax goes live at midnight,
and Congo's count rolls past three thousand one hundred.
Losing ground — but not the whole field:
a coal plant learns to hold the sun,
and something quick enough to steer a star
is learning where the plasma bends.
